label: AI-Assisted Summary
summary:
Genesis 6 shows how far people had turned away from God. The earth became full of violence, and the Bible says that people's thoughts were evil all the time. God was deeply grieved by what had happened to the world He created.

But one man was different. Noah walked with God. Because of this, God chose Noah and his family to be saved from the coming flood.

God told Noah to build a huge ark. Many people wonder how all the animals got onto the ark. The Bible explains that the animals would come to Noah. God, who created every creature, was able to guide them to the ark so they could be kept safe.

This chapter reminds us that even when the world becomes very dark, God still sees those who walk with Him and provides a way to preserve life.
